event_summary: A brown round object and an orange rectangular piece descend from upper holders and come to rest on two adjacent white cushions.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two large white cushions side by side at the bottom, a brown round object near a blue claw-like holder at the upper left, and an orange rectangular piece near an orange-and-black holder at the upper right. For many frames the arrangement is still. Later the brown round object moves downward toward the left cushion while the orange rectangular piece moves downward toward the right cushion. The brown object contacts the left cushion and ends tilted on it; the orange piece contacts the right cushion and ends lying on it. The upper holders remain visible near the top after the objects are no longer beside them.

reasons: Two white cushions are visible in the lower half of the frame.
The brown round object and orange rectangular object are visible near the top before their later movement.
No scene-object motion is visible in the first frame.
